title: Evaluating Large Language Models on the Frame and Symbol Grounding Problems: A Zero-shot Benchmark
reasoning: The paper evaluates cognitive and philosophical challenges in AI, specifically the Frame Problem (information selection in navigation) and the Symbol Grounding Problem (abstract meaning construction). While it mentions these problems are significant to epistemology, it does not evaluate religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical frameworks; the tasks are focused on urban routing and semantic internalization of an imaginary object.
